summary_en: This study tests mosunetuzumab alone or with zanubrutinib in adults with newly diagnosed follicular lymphoma who need systemic therapy. Mosunetuzumab is given under the skin, with step-up doses in cycle 1 and then a 45 mg dose each 3-week cycle, and zanubrutinib is given continuously for 12 months in cohort 2. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba mosunetuzumab solo o con zanubrutinib en adultos con linfoma folicular recién diagnosticado que necesitan tratamiento sistémico. El mosunetuzumab se administra debajo de la piel, con dosis escalonadas en el ciclo 1 y luego una dosis de 45 mg en cada ciclo de 3 semanas, y el zanubrutinib se administra de forma continua durante 12 meses en la cohorte 2. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with newly diagnosed follicular lymphoma grade 1, 2, or 3A that has not been treated.
Need for systemic therapy, such as bulky disease, certain symptoms, or low blood counts caused by lymphoma.
Considered a candidate for chemoimmunotherapy by the treating physician.
At least one measurable lesion on CT or MRI scan.
not_for: Follicular lymphoma grade 3B or transformed follicular lymphoma.
Current or prior central nervous system lymphoma.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
Known active infection, or positive results on certain hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV tests.
